prerequisites: Know how to build a PERT network
Know how to create a Project Breakdown Structure
Have already been confronted with industrial projects

learning_outcomes.text: Know the tasks of a project manager
Lay out the scope or scoping note of a project in order to characterize it
Identify project risks and rate them (criticality)
Have several strategies to protect themselves from risks
Associate a probability with a probable duration of the project (probabilistic PERT)
Know how to plan a project by integrating risks
Know how to perform a risk analysis
Identify possible mitigation actions and prioritize them
Know how to define the scope of a project
Understand a project and its loops from the PERT network
Calculate the probability that a loop will become critical and a duration for a given probability
Be aware of the project leader’s decision-making authority and the complexity of managing a project due to numerous hazards and disruptions

syllabus_topics: Course introduction
Understanding the context of the case study
Team Building and Project Leader Identification
Setting of project objectives
Identification of clients and stakeholders
Identification of key project deliverables
Identification of tasks
Establishment of the logical network and the PERT network (reminder of principles)
Methods for project acceleration
Integration of risks into the project
Simulation of the project in the form of a game
Team debriefing on project completion
Analysis of the case study
Highlighting concepts to be retained and pitfalls to be avoided
Presentation of the FMEA project approach and its 4 phases)
Additional information on the use of the FMEA method and risk criticality
Assessment of the criticality of the risks in the case study
Calculation of the probability that a loop becomes critical
Integration of the PERT Probabilistic and Calculus into the case study
Conclusion on the importance of risk analysis in projects
teaching_methods: serious game (board game) with simulation of the realization of an industrial project
team work under the responsibility of a project manager
debriefing on the experiences and understandings acquired during the simulation
